176. Destiny for the Two (2)
"Father..."
Jin poured a drink into his own glass and stared at the far sky.
His father, elder sister, and the black knights who were the strongest in the family history, he thought of the Black Sea expedition team, and it felt like mud was boiling inside him.
The reason why Jin had not left to find the expedition team was simple.
The world's best sword and the strongest martial artists of the present day have set out to find the end of the Black Sea, an endless mystery.
Following them was a near-impossible task, and Ticane. No, Inse was not in a situation where it was alright for him to be absent.
Zed left to find Chiron after resisting Rosa's tyranny, and Munmyeong said he would deploy forces to the Black Sea as soon as things were settled with Yona...
However, Jin had an intuition that the only way for news from the expedition to reach Inse would be for a member of the expedition to return directly.
"I felt that you admired my father when we first met in the Sota desert."
"Admiration... That's not wrong. If I had to correct it, it would be closer to reverence."
"Did you ever lose to my father in the Black Sea?"
Hedo let out a chuckle.
"You're asking the obvious. Who could possibly resist Chiron and not be defeated? The first time I saw Chiron, I couldn't even exchange a single stroke of the sword with him."
"How long had it been since you entered the Black Sea?"

"It was about ten years later. In those ten years, I not only fought against the monsters but also had life-and-death fights with numerous other warriors who, like me, came to the Black Sea. I chose the Black Sea as a refuge, but there were surprisingly many martial artists who came for training. There were more than five hundred that I met."
"Five hundred? Were there that many martial artists who chose the Black Sea as their training ground?"
"It's the perfect place for seclusion. Besides, I only found out after I left the Black Sea. In that era, the Black Sea was widely recognized by the people as the land of Chiron."
Chiron often visited the Black Sea, away from the Garden of Swords, since his younger days.
The fact that he was secretly making a map of the Black Sea with his knights is still highly confidential, but the fact that he trained there for a long time is well known to everyone.

"In your time, no one has challenged Chiron. But it was different in those days. Not only the archers and the sword emperor, but also the so-called martial artists and magicians of each power, and even the masters in the field, were all eager to cross swords with Chiron."
As the story of the previous era began, Jin suddenly became aware of Hedo's age.
Despite his incredibly huge muscles, he was of a similar age to Chiron.
"It was a romantic era."

"It may seem that way to the warriors of this era. But those who challenged Chiron directly, they wouldn't be able to find romance anywhere in that time. The achievements they dedicated their lives to, were nothing more than trivialities in front of Chiron."
Many giants turned into dust in the Black Sea due to Chiron's sword.
Those who were known and those who were not, but were at a higher level than them.

"Most challengers didn't even get a chance to fight, and those who could have had a meaningful battle fell into despair and either became invalids or disappeared. The ones who survived till the end, hoping for a chance, were the family heads like the archers, or the Sword Emperor... I think we could drink to the Sword Emperor."
Both of them raised their glasses to the sky and emptied them.
"You must have been part of that too."

"I later realized that I was in the middle of that turbulent era. At the time, I was unaware of the external situation, and didn't even know that the world's greatest sword was in my refuge. The only reason I learned the name of Chiron was because some of the martial artists who occasionally visited the Black Sea mistook me for him."
"They mistook you for my father?"

"Many challengers came, but the Black Sea is vast. Besides, the terrain changes at a whim, so those who happened to meet Chiron were lucky. Many ended their lives in the Black Sea after a long search for Chiron, unable to find their way back."
"That seems likely."

"You probably haven't had the chance to go to the Black Sea alone yet. If you walk alone in that dark land... most people would go mad. Challengers would draw their swords as soon as they met anything while wandering in the Black Sea. They didn't discriminate between humans and monsters. But at that time, I was one of the stronger ones among those who visited the Black Sea, so I was mistaken for Chiron."
"Was there anyone among them who beat you?"
"No. Probably because I didn't encounter the archers or the Sword Emperor. I was clearly weaker than them at the time."
Even though he was a boneless person chosen by the heavens, all of Hedo's achievements were purely self-taught.
He couldn't help but be weaker than those who had inherited the martial arts lineage, with the same special condition of being boneless.
Hedo was most aware of this fact around that time.
There were several times when he had a hard time against challengers who had worthless bodies.
The swordsmanship that Hedo practiced at the time was wild and destructive, but it lacked depth.
"However, there were some people who weren't challengers but drove me overwhelmingly close to death."
"The Black Knights of the previous generations, my father's knights, it seems. The first one was Sir Vanessa."
"That's right. While I had ended up dueling those who coincidentally wanted to challenge Chiron, Vanessa had a purpose when she came to find me."
"Pretending to be a family head is a serious crime, whether intentional or not.
-What are you?
-But if you have a more useful purpose, you might have a chance to meet a family head alive.
-What nonsense are you talking about?"
When Hedo explained the conversation he had with Vanessa at that time, Jin's pupils widened.
"It seems like my father wanted to recruit you, Tower Keeper. Lady Vanessa would have assessed your abilities and if communication was possible, she would have taken you to my father."
"That seems likely."
While it was not known to the world, Hedo had enough reputation in the Black Sea to draw Chiron's attention. It was indeed a peculiar case.
Moreover, if he had been recruited at that time, Hedo would not have become a housekeeper of Zephyr, but a Black Knight of Runcandel.
"I was defeated by Vanessa in just over ten minutes. It was the first such shock."
"Somehow, I feel like my shoulders are shrinking."
"And I ran away like a dog. Just like the monsters fleeing from me, showing all kinds of disgrace."
"I can't imagine you doing that."
"Think again. What would the form of a person who never received education and never left the Black Sea since he was fifteen look like?"
With that, it was not hard to imagine.
"...You were probably like a beast, or a monster."
The Hedo of that time, who was always in a wrinkle-free shirt and suit, and who used polite speech, was completely different from the current Hedo.
"I ran away screaming. I threw away everything that came to hand, and even lost control of my bodily functions. I couldn't even think about being ashamed. All I could think of was surviving."
"What happened next?"

"Since I knew the Black Sea a bit better than Vanessa, I managed to escape. I hid and focused on recovering, but a feeling I had never experienced before tortured me. Shame and a sense of defeat. I first realized these ordinary emotions then, along with a desire for revenge."
From that day on, Hedo devoted himself to training to defeat Vanessa.
In fact, surviving in the Black Sea itself was training, so life didn't change particularly, but he gained a goal.
"I looked for stronger monsters in deeper areas than usual, and fought with challengers wandering there for a few more years. The black sword I used to call Bale...."
Hedo paused for a moment.
The original name of the long sword he called Bale was not that.
The real Bale, who is now a member of Sandra's family, called that sword 'Shakan'.
Hedo did not retrieve Shakan from Bale.
"It's a simple matter of Sandra giving a single command, but without Shakan, Bale cannot exert its full power.
"……I got it at that time. The monster using the power of chaos was the one who had Shakan. I don't know why the old Runcandel's tenth knight's sword was with it."
"Hmm, you could ask Bale directly about that. Wait a moment, I'm out of liquor."
Jin went back to the restaurant and brought a new bottle of liquor.
"He said he lost it while fighting with the old knights in the Black Sea before he was sealed. Losing the sword was crucial for the seal. The monster probably acquired it by chance."
Gulp, gulp, gulp... The cup was refilled again.

"I didn't expect to hear such stories all of a sudden. I will definitely make you a new sword to your liking. My third sister is going to bring a great blacksmith from Huphester soon. A man named Vin Bransh."
"I've never heard of him."
"He's an incarnation of Picon Mente, you can look forward to him. So, did you challenge Lady Vanessa again after getting the sword?"

"I challenged her again but I couldn't beat her. Even though I had become even stronger than Vanessa. I finally won once after fighting three more times. It took about a year to find and meet each time, so for several years I chased Chiron and his knights, continuously attacking them."
"Did you fight with other knights as well as Lady Vanessa?"
"I probably fought with almost all the Black Knights who were in the Black Sea."
"But you survived against all odds."
"Chiron saw me as a cute wild animal, that's why I was able to survive."
"He called you a cute wild animal?"

"In a dreadful land with nothing but darkness and desolation, and monsters... I was a challenger who didn't need to be an example. Chiron always took seriously the humans who came to challenge him in that land, but treated me like a stray cat."
Jin tried to picture Hedo and a stray cat at the same time, but of course, he couldn't find any similarity.
"A stray cat. Is that even possible?"

"Back then, I was already looking at 10 stars based solely on the magnitude of my strength. I don't think Chiron, who always saw me as insignificant, would have died in the Black Sea. Besides, with the White Knight and the Black Knights from those days all there together, you should stop worrying about your father."
Jin's pupils widened.
Since the story of Chiron first came up, Jin had been unknowingly a bit deflated and continued the conversation.
Hedo noticed that and was considerate of him.
"Thank you. But Tower Keeper, why didn't you become my father's knight then?"
